incident.injected_fault: The catalog Service forwards to targetPort 8080 while the selected catalog containers listen on port 8081.
observable_signals: Requests through the catalog Service fail with connection refused or HTTP 503.

preconditions: Catalog pods are ready and listen on port 8081.

The benchmark client can reach the Service ClusterIP.
required_evidence: Capture the Service port and targetPort.
Capture the selected pod containerPort and listening socket.
Compare failing Service probes with successful direct-pod probes.

payload.answer: The catalog-api service had targetPort configured to 8080, but the underlying catalog-api pods and nginx configuration listen on port 8081 (named catalog-http). The mismatch caused connection failures to endpoints. Patching the service targetPort to port 8081 / catalog-http resolves the routing issue.

critical_claims.claim: The catalog-api Service in namespace proofix-case-03 was configured with targetPort 8080, causing endpoints to expose port 8080.

The catalog-api Service targetPort mismatch was resolved by patching the Service.
